description: This file defines Orleans grain interface types related to testing scenarios, specifically 'IStuckGrain' and 'IStuckCleanGrain' interfaces with methods for simulating stuck behaviors and management.

methods.name: RunForever
methods.description: Starts an indefinite or long-running process, likely for testing a stuck state.

methods.name: NonBlockingCall
methods.description: Initiates a non-blocking operation to test concurrent behavior.

methods.name: GetNonBlockingCallCounter
methods.description: Returns the count of non-blocking calls received.

methods.name: DidActivationTryToStart
methods.description: Checks if the grain activation attempted to start with a specific GrainId.

methods.name: BlockingDeactivation
methods.description: Performs a blocking deactivation of the grain, possibly to test deactivation behavior.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases or unlocks resources associated with the specified key.

methods.name: IsActivated
methods.description: Checks if a grain with the specified key is currently activated.
